components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A bold inverse action; plugin pages replace white with their current signal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:44px; padding:.65rem .75rem; color:var(--ground,#0b0d10); background:var(--text,#f2f5f7); border:1px solid var(--text,#f2f5f7); border-radius:12px; box-shadow:none; font:700 1rem/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#8ac7ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter:brightness(.84); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A compact secondary action for archive and similar low-emphasis operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height:40px; padding:.45rem .7rem; color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#414b56); border-radius:12px; box-shadow:none; font:700 .9rem/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); background:var(--surface-raised,#1a1f25); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#8ac7ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { background:var(--surface,#14181d); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A visibly labeled, recessed native field for server-rendered forms.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">Name<input class="ds-field" id="ds-field" value="Morning blend"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:grid; gap:.35rem; color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); font:650 .82rem/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height:44px; padding:.65rem .75rem; color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); background:var(--field,#101318); border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#414b56); border-radius:12px; font:400 1rem/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#8ac7ff); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Launcher Tile
components.description: A compact neutral destination with a domain-colored Lucide-derived icon.
components.html: GoalsMeasurements and progress
components.css: .ds-launcher { min-height:112px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:clamp(.65rem,2.5vw,1.2rem); padding:clamp(.7rem,2.5vw,1.35rem); color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); background:var(--surface,#14181d); border:1px solid var(--line,#2c333b); border-radius:14px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-launcher:hover { background:var(--surface-raised,#1a1f25); border-color:var(--line-strong,#414b56); } .ds-launcher:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#8ac7ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-launcher svg { width:clamp(32px,6vw,68px); fill:none; stroke:var(--goals,#9bd47b); stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-launcher span { min-width:0; display:grid; gap:.15rem; } .ds-launcher strong { font:700 clamp(1.05rem,3.2vw,2.15rem)/1.05 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-launcher small { overflow:hidden; color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Instrument Readings
components.description: The ruled four-reading block at the top of a plugin instrument panel.
components.css: .ds-instrument { padding:clamp(1rem,3vw,1.75rem); color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); background:var(--surface,#14181d); border:1px solid var(--line,#2c333b); border-radius:14px; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-instrument header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; } .ds-instrument h2 { margin:0; font-size:1rem; } .ds-instrument header span { color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-instrument dl { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); margin:1rem 0 0; border-block:1px solid var(--line,#2c333b); } .ds-instrument dl div { min-width:0; padding:1rem 0; } .ds-instrument dt { color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:650; } .ds-instrument dd { margin:.25rem 0 0; color:var(--coffee,#79bce8); font-size:clamp(1.15rem,3vw,1.8rem); font-weight:750; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media(max-width:760px){.ds-instrument dl{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));}.ds-instrument dl div{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2c333b);}}

components.name: Records Panel
components.description: A single outer panel with native disclosure rows and internal rules.
components.css: .ds-records { padding:clamp(1rem,3vw,1.5rem); color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); background:var(--surface,#14181d); border:1px solid var(--line,#2c333b); border-radius:14px; font:400 1rem/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-records header,.ds-records summary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; } .ds-records h2 { margin:0 0 .75rem; font-size:1rem; } .ds-records header>span,.ds-records summary>span:last-child,.ds-records small { color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); } .ds-records details { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2c333b); } .ds-records summary { min-height:68px; padding:.9rem .15rem; cursor:pointer; } .ds-records summary>span:first-child { display:grid; } .ds-records details:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#8ac7ff); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A 56px dark rail with plugin links in shipped order and an icon-only sign-out action.
components.html:
Hublet
GoalsFoodRecipesCoffee
components.css: .ds-nav { height:56px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; padding:0 1rem; color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); background:var(--ground,#0b0d10); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2c333b); font:650 .84rem/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#8ac7ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-brand { color:var(--text,#f2f5f7)!important; font-size:1rem; font-weight:760; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-nav>div { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem; } .ds-nav button { width:44px; height:44px; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:0; color:var(--muted,#a9b2bc); background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:12px; } .ds-nav button:hover { color:var(--text,#f2f5f7); background:var(--surface,#14181d); border-color:var(--line,#2c333b); } .ds-nav svg { width:19px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }

narrative.overview:
Hublet is a compact bank of instruments used to check personal facts in seconds. Matte near-black infrastructure, ruled charcoal surfaces, pale readings, and one quiet signal color per plugin make the interface feel precise and calm without borrowing the spectacle of an analytics suite.

The system is native, factual, and dense enough for an iPhone. Status and charts occupy the first useful viewport; controls and history wait below. There are no ornamental layers, slogans, web fonts, or decorative motion. Lucide-derived line icons and tabular numerals carry most of the visual character.
keyCharacteristics: Matte dark ground with bordered charcoal instrument surfaces.
Modern system sans throughout, with tight headings and tabular readings.
Restrained Goals, Food, Recipes, and Coffee signal colors.
A compact two-column launcher built for up to eight plugins.
Inline charts and current status before forms, history, or definitions.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Surface Rule
rules.body: Plugin colors belong on icons, live values, chart marks, and contextual actions; large panels stay neutral.

rules.name: The Food Means Read Rule
rules.body: Food may use its amber signal for nutrition status, but the web dashboard exposes no Food mutation controls.

rules.name: The One Native Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce web fonts or a separate display face; the system sans is part of Hublet's speed and restraint.

rules.name: The Numbers Hold Still Rule
rules.body: Measurements, counts, dates, chart endpoints, and status numerals use tabular figures wherever alignment changes over time.

rules.name: The Read, Then Act Rule
rules.body: Every plugin opens on current status; forms, histories, and definitions begin below the first instrument panel.

rules.name: The Eight-Fit Rule
rules.body: Preserve the launcher's two-column, viewport-fitted behavior for up to eight destinations; do not turn it into a scrolling card feed at the supported limit.

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Boundaries come from color and lines; never add shadows to panels, tiles, navigation, or controls.

rules.name: The Outer Radius Rule
rules.body: Round the containing instrument, not every row inside it.

dos: **Do** keep the first useful viewport devoted to current status, progress, and charts.
**Do** preserve the compact two-column launcher and the Goals, Food, Recipes, Coffee order.
**Do** use semantic server-rendered HTML, native disclosures, visible labels, and accessible SVG titles.
**Do** keep all essential interaction targets at least 44px tall, except the intentionally compact 40px quiet button.
**Do** use internal rules to organize dense records and histories inside one outer panel.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, gradients, glass effects, decorative animation, or ornamental card stacks.
**Don't** introduce web fonts, icon fonts, external assets, JavaScript charts, or frontend-framework assumptions.
**Don't** fill large surfaces with plugin colors or use those signals as decoration.
**Don't** put forms above the current-status instrument panel.
**Don't** add Food mutation controls to the web dashboard while Food remains read-only there.
